# Indicators Summary


## About These Summaries

These summaries present key regional indicators for the West of England Combined Authority's priority areas. The indicators measure progress against the [West of England Growth Strategy](https://www.westofengland-ca.gov.uk/about-us/our-strategy/west-of-england-growth-plan/). They are not intended to directly measure outcomes or outputs for WECA projects, but rather to provide a high-level overview of regional trends and performance.

## Priority Areas

| Section | Priority Area |
|---------|--------------|
| 2 | Contributing to national economic growth helping our businesses succeed and creating jobs |
| 3 | Connecting the region through public transport & active travel |
| 4 | Building affordable and attractive homes in sustainable communities |
| 5 | Empowering residents with the skills to access the jobs that will shape our future |
| 6 | Making the West of England the home for green jobs and green growth |
| 7 | Lifting children and families out of poverty in the West of England |

- Use the **sidebar navigation** to jump to any chapter

## Data Sources

Indicators draw on a range of national and local data sources. Each chapter documents its specific sources within the analysis. Data refresh schedules are noted where applicable.
